correctness.rationale: Boolean 4-state de Bruijn matrices capture exactly cyclic preimages including length 1 and 2; reachable-relation vector updates compute the image size exactly. The block-diagonal Cayley–Hamilton theorem proves that every verified agreement of d_r+d_s consecutive coefficients extends to all n. The packaged exact standard-library computation checks the complete 40-group partition, 48 within-group equalities through rigorous dimension bounds (up to 4750), sharp n<=6 differences, and independently brute forces all 256 rules through ring length 11. Executed checker produced VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The exact all-length classification collapses 88 conventional rule families to 40 inverse-reachability cardinality signatures, with two sixfold collisions and a sharp six-cell distinguishing cutoff. It settles a natural global finite-ring invariant classification and quantifies how far image-cardinality equivalence diverges from ordinary automaton symmetry, useful for Garden-of-Eden/information-loss comparisons rather than an arbitrary finite census.
